beschreibung: W-048: Porträts für Unter, Ober und König im deutschen/bayerischen Blatt (Eichel, Gras, Herz, Schellen), 12 Motive. Eigene Tiere, damit sich das Blatt vom französischen unterscheidet; Stilvorlage sind der Narrenhof-Bär und die gewählten französischen Könige.
stil: Painterly Old-Master style portrait of an anthropomorphic animal in costume, in the same style as the reference images: dark warm background with subtle damask pattern, rich velvet, brocade and fur trim, soft light, warm gold and deep colours, detailed expressive face, dignified with a touch of humour, bust portrait facing the viewer. Figure of a traditional German playing-card deck (Unter = young soldier, Ober = officer with feathered hat, König = king with crown). Vertical composition, figure centred with space around so it can be cropped. No text, no letters, no numbers, no card frame.
ohne: text, watermark, border, frame, playing card layout, miniature playing cards or card corners as jewellery, candles at the image edge, real people, celebrities, modern clothing
